references.title: A record with context
references.take: A stable record header, focused tabs, a history timeline and a separate details column.
references.adapt: Use for applications, members, businesses and inquiries. Keep the next action beside the record identity.
references.avoid: Sales pipeline language, enrichment and unnecessary CRM fields.

references.title: Make access explicit
references.take: Email and permission level appear together before the invitation action.
references.adapt: Show the named recipient and granted capabilities. Separate staff access from cooperative membership.
references.avoid: Bulk invitations before reviewing permissions; a long mandatory onboarding tour.

references.title: A queue you can scan
references.take: A quiet table keeps project name, owner, target date and status aligned. A side summary adds context.
references.adapt: Use a list first for projects and operational work. Emphasize ownership and next dates.
references.avoid: Developer terminology and a second navigation layer for a small team.

references.title: Every number has a scope
references.take: The reporting period and filters sit above the metric and chart.
references.adapt: Keep date, timezone, metric definition and coverage visible. Offer a readable table alongside charts.
references.avoid: Payment-taking controls and unsupported financial claims.

references.title: Totals that explain themselves
references.take: Expandable report groups expose the components behind totals and specify the time window.
references.adapt: Separate period activity from current snapshots, and payments from investment commitments.
references.avoid: Copying Square's accounting categories before WisConnect approves its definitions.

references.title: One clear recovery action
references.take: A focused recovery form, help path and explicit return to login.
references.adapt: Email recovery with visible labels, inline errors and a predictable back path.
references.avoid: Promotional content competing with account recovery.

references.title: Explain what happens next
references.take: An explicit check-email result and a resend cooldown, with wording that does not confirm account existence.
references.adapt: Explain delivery delay, spam-folder checks and the next permitted resend time.
references.avoid: Claiming successful delivery just because a request was accepted.

references.title: Choose the destination first
references.take: The destination is visible before confirming an upload.
references.adapt: Name the project or member record and the private audience before upload. Keep access restricted until policy is approved.
references.avoid: Assuming a folder or copied link is safe to share publicly.

references.title: Keep file outcomes visible
references.take: A persistent upload tray distinguishes completed, skipped and failed files, with a clear success result.
references.adapt: Show progress and retry per file. Keep uploading separate from validation and availability.
references.avoid: Calling a transfer complete while the file is still being checked.

flows.name: Access & recovery
flows.summary: Get into the right workspace, with a way back when something goes wrong.
flows.route: Returning staff: A01 → A07 if enabled → H01. Invitation: A05 → H01. Recovery: A02 → A03 → A04 → A01. Invalid links: A06 → request replacement.
flows.policy: Staff invitation access must be explicit. Administrator MFA and recovery are proposed production safeguards, still to build.

screens.name: Sign in
screens.description: Recognizable WisConnect identity, email and password, visible labels and one primary action.
screens.rule: Generic failed-sign-in message; preserve email, allow password managers, rate-limit with a retry time. Return to the originally requested authorized page.

screens.name: Forgot password
screens.description: Ask for the account email and explain the recovery path.
screens.rule: Use identical wording for known and unknown accounts. Never display a password or account-existence confirmation.

screens.name: Check your email
screens.description: Confirm the request, explain delivery delay and provide a resend path.
screens.rule: Request accepted is not proof of delivery. Show cooldown and delivery-help copy; stay on this screen after retries.

screens.name: Choose a new password
screens.description: A valid, single-use recovery link opens a focused password form.
screens.rule: Inline requirements, show/hide controls, matching confirmation and expired-link recovery. Success returns to sign in.

screens.name: Accept an invitation
screens.description: Show the workspace, fixed invited email and access being offered before account setup.
screens.rule: Accepting account access does not approve cooperative membership. Handle already-accepted, revoked and expired invitations separately.

screens.name: Link unavailable
screens.description: A calm explanation for expired, revoked or already-used invitation/recovery links.
screens.rule: Give a safe route to request a replacement from an administrator. Never loop users back to the same invalid link.

screens.name: Verify your identity
screens.description: Proposed authenticator challenge with a recovery-code alternative.
screens.rule: Show only when MFA is configured or required. Define enrollment, lost-device recovery and reauthentication before production; not implemented today.

flows.name: Start the day
flows.summary: See what needs attention and reach a useful next action quickly.
flows.route: H01 → the selected work queue. Search is an optional shortcut. Help remains available from every screen.
flows.policy: Counts must come from authorized records. No invented member, finance or impact statistics.

screens.name: Needs your attention
screens.description: Lead with new applications, follow-ups due and invitations needing action. Show recent work underneath.
screens.rule: Independent section loading and retry; stale counts labeled with last refresh. A zero count means caught up, not an error.

screens.name: Find a record
screens.description: Optional search across records the signed-in user can access, with type labels and direct links.
screens.rule: Begin with excellent search inside each module. Global search is a later convenience; never reveal inaccessible record titles in results.

screens.name: Help & guidance
screens.description: Short task guides, a glossary of statuses and an agreed support path.
screens.rule: Help opens beside the task or returns to the same record. Support contact and response expectations still need an owner.

flows.name: Application → account access
flows.summary: Review a person, record the next step, and invite only when explicitly chosen.
flows.route: P01 → P02 → P03 → P02. Optional account handoff: P04 → P05 → A05. Membership remains a separate decision at M04.
flows.policy: Keep New / Reviewing / Waiting. The team must define approval, decline and membership eligibility before those decisions are built.

screens.name: Applications queue
screens.description: Search, status, reviewer and oldest-first sorting. Enter from Home with the intended filter already applied.
screens.rule: Preserve filters and scroll when returning from a record. Distinguish no applications from no matching results.

screens.name: Application review
screens.description: Submission, assigned reviewer, private notes and chronological history in one record.
screens.rule: Make notes explicitly private. Show the latest saved state and any existing linked account or invitation.

screens.name: Save review & next step
screens.description: Set review status and reviewer, then add a clear internal note.
screens.rule: Validate inline; keep draft after failure. If another person edited it, compare the latest version before saving again.

screens.name: Confirm account invitation
screens.description: Show the application, fixed email address and exact account access being offered.
screens.rule: Explicit send confirmation, duplicate prevention and auditable retries. Do not change membership standing or review status automatically.

screens.name: Invitation status
screens.description: Separate pending, accepted, expired and revoked invitations from mail delivery state.
screens.rule: Never equate Sent with Accepted. Resend and revoke require clear outcomes, history and a duplicate-safe retry path.

flows.name: Know each member
flows.summary: Separate personal details, account access and cooperative membership standing.
flows.route: M01 → M02 → M03 → M02. Membership decision is a separate, policy-gated path at M04.
flows.policy: Do not infer membership from an active login or an accepted invitation. Eligibility, consensus, dues and decision authority await the team.

screens.name: Member directory
screens.description: Find people by name, location and verified standing; keep account status clearly labeled.
screens.rule: Until a formal member registry exists, label the current account directory accurately. Do not count every account as a member.

screens.name: Member record
screens.description: Contact profile, linked business, projects, authorized documents and history.
screens.rule: Account access and membership standing are separate fields. Each linked section follows its own permission checks.

screens.name: Edit member details
screens.description: A short labeled form for agreed profile fields, with explicit Save and Cancel.
screens.rule: Preserve draft on error, warn before leaving with edits, and record meaningful changes in history.

screens.name: Membership decision
screens.description: Reserved for the team's approved eligibility and decision process.
screens.rule: Do not enable approval/decline, standing changes or dues calculations until policy, required evidence and authorized roles are approved.

flows.name: Business → public directory
flows.summary: Work privately, preview exactly what is public, then publish deliberately.
flows.route: B01 → B02 → B03 → B04 → B05 → B02. Archive/restore is a separate action at B06.
flows.policy: Private owner/contact/notes stay private. Existing approved images and attribution must be preserved.

screens.name: Businesses queue
screens.description: Search by business, owner, location and draft/published/archived status.
screens.rule: Show draft changes separately from the currently published listing. Return to the same filtered queue.

screens.name: Business record
screens.description: The public listing, private owner information, draft status and publication history share one stable record.
screens.rule: The live version stays visible until a new draft is explicitly published.

screens.name: Edit business draft
screens.description: Clear groups for public content, private contacts, and images with attribution.
screens.rule: Uploads need size/type checks, progress and retry. Warn on unsaved navigation. Saving a draft never publishes it.

screens.name: Public listing preview
screens.description: Show only the public card and detail content, including mobile behavior.
screens.rule: Flag missing required public fields and distinguish illustrative imagery from real business imagery.

screens.name: Confirm publication
screens.description: Name the business and summarize the public changes before publishing.
screens.rule: Confirm actual publish success before showing Published. Production integration is still needed for the static public site.

screens.name: Archive or restore
screens.description: Explain removal from the public directory and preservation of the private record/history.
screens.rule: Use reversible archive with an explicit restore path. Restore should state whether it restores a draft or republishes, before confirmation.

flows.name: Inquiry → follow-up
flows.summary: One responsible person, a visible due date, and an honest outcome.
flows.route: I01 → I02 → I03 → I02. Reply happens in the email app; closure is explicitly recorded here.
flows.policy: Notification delivery is independent from whether someone replied. No automatic replies or inferred read receipts.

screens.name: Inquiry inbox
screens.description: Open, In progress and Closed queues, with owner and follow-up date filters.
screens.rule: Use actual workflow state for attention counts. Label overdue dates and notification failures independently.

screens.name: Inquiry conversation
screens.description: Original message first, owner and due date beside it, private notes/history underneath.
screens.rule: Open email app is an external handoff. Opening it never marks an inquiry replied or closed.

screens.name: Assign, schedule or close
screens.description: Update owner, follow-up date and status, then record a private note.
screens.rule: Keep entered content on failure and warn on conflicts. Show calendar dates with their agreed timezone semantics.

flows.name: Project → progress
flows.summary: Give each initiative an owner, next milestone and supporting records.
flows.route: J01 → J03 → J02 → J04 → J02. Project files link directly to D01/D03.
flows.policy: Project fields and completion criteria are proposed. Confirm owners, statuses and required reporting with the team.

screens.name: Project portfolio
screens.description: A compact list of initiative, owner, status and next milestone date.
screens.rule: Include first-project empty state, filters and permission-aware create controls. Avoid a board until the workflow requires one.

screens.name: Project workspace
screens.description: Overview, milestones, linked people/businesses, documents and update history.
screens.rule: One clearly accountable owner; surface overdue milestones without treating missing data as failed work.

screens.name: Create or edit a project
screens.description: Name, purpose, owner, agreed status and milestone dates in a simple form.
screens.rule: Validate date order and required ownership. Save only confirmed data; avoid fabricated budgets or completion percentages.

screens.name: Progress update & completion
screens.description: Record progress, blockers and the next step. Completion is a deliberate status change.
screens.rule: Completion criteria must be agreed. Record actor and time; allow a documented reopen path.

flows.name: Document → trusted file
flows.summary: Know where a file belongs, who can see it, and which version is current.
flows.route: D01 → D02 → D03. Replace with a new version via D04. Inspect access or archive at D05.
flows.policy: Start with administrators only. The team must approve any wider audience; handbook and operating agreement remain private.

screens.name: Document library
screens.description: Find a file by name, linked record, type and current version. Show access visibly.
screens.rule: Search and download obey the same permissions. Never expose private filenames to an unauthorized user.

screens.name: Upload & validate
screens.description: Select destination and audience before transfer. Show progress and results per file.
screens.rule: Uploading → checking → ready or failed. Reject unsafe/oversized files; let one failed file retry without repeating successful uploads.

screens.name: File preview & details
screens.description: Readable preview, filename, owner, destination, version and current access in one place.
screens.rule: Offer an authorized download when preview is unavailable. Expired download access should refresh safely without making the file public.

screens.name: Version history
screens.description: Replace a document without losing earlier versions and the reason for the change.
screens.rule: Keep the current version usable until the new file passes validation. Every version retains actor, time and access restrictions.

screens.name: Access & archive
screens.description: Show the current audience clearly. Archive retains history; restoring is explicit.
screens.rule: Wider sharing is blocked pending the team's policy. A copy-link action must never silently create public access.

flows.name: Financial record → audit trail
flows.summary: Track agreed payment, investment and sales records with clear provenance.
flows.route: F01 → F02 → F03. Corrections use F04 and retain the original history. Reports read these records at R02.
flows.policy: Record keeping only. No checkout, charges, transfers or inferred dues. Team must define currencies, categories, verification and who can see records.

screens.name: Finance register
screens.description: Separate views for payments, investment commitments/receipts and sales records.
screens.rule: Never sum different currencies or combine pledged and received investments. Missing records do not mean a zero balance.

screens.name: Record financial activity
screens.description: Type, amount, currency, date, linked party/project, reference and evidence.
screens.rule: Validate amount and currency, warn about duplicate references and restrict sensitive fields. Saving records never moves money.

screens.name: Financial record detail
screens.description: A clear amount/currency with record type, evidence, verification status and full history.
screens.rule: Show who entered and verified the record. Verification authority and approval requirements must be defined by the team.

screens.name: Correct or void a record
screens.description: Show the original, proposed correction and required reason before confirming.
screens.rule: Do not silently overwrite or permanently delete financial history. Void/correction behavior requires agreed policy.

flows.name: Question → trustworthy report
flows.summary: Make every report explain its sources, date scope and limitations.
flows.route: R01 → R02 → R03. Drill-down returns to the originating records with matching filters.
flows.policy: Original scope includes financial, sales, membership, activity and impact reports. Only operational activity is implemented today; definitions and source records are needed for the rest.

screens.name: Reports hub
screens.description: Five clear report categories with availability and definition notes.
screens.rule: Unavailable reports say what data/definition is missing. Do not show fabricated sample statistics in the real dashboard.

screens.name: Report & drill-down
screens.description: Period, timezone, coverage, last refresh, summary metrics, readable table and record links.
screens.rule: Current snapshots and period events are distinct. Preserve the last result while a new range loads, and label it until refreshed.

screens.name: Export options & outcome
screens.description: Confirm the report, included columns, period and access before preparing CSV.
screens.rule: Export only authorized data and neutralize spreadsheet formulas. Say Download started, not Download complete, unless completion is known.

flows.name: Team & permissions
flows.summary: Grant the smallest useful access and make changes understandable.
flows.route: T01 → T02 → T03 → T01. New staff invitation: T04 → A05. Offboarding revokes active access.
flows.policy: Team role names and responsibilities need approval. New permission code exists locally but is not counted as verified complete.

screens.name: Team directory
screens.description: Staff, access summary, account state and pending invitations in one place.
screens.rule: Only authorized staff see account administration. Preserve last-administrator protection and clear deactivation/reactivation outcomes.

screens.name: Permission editor
screens.description: Group capabilities by Applications, Businesses, Inquiries, Documents, Finance, Reports and Administration.
screens.rule: Permissions are enforced server-side, not just hidden in the navigation. The editor must not grant beyond the actor's authority.

screens.name: Confirm access change
screens.description: Summarize who gains or loses which capabilities and the effect on active sessions.
screens.rule: Sensitive changes require reauthentication, audit history and explicit success. Prevent removing the final administrator.

screens.name: Invite a staff member
screens.description: Enter email, assign approved capabilities and review the exact access before sending.
screens.rule: Handle existing accounts and pending invites. Real production delivery remains a release gate; no automatic membership approval.

flows.name: Your account & safe exit
flows.summary: Keep personal settings, security and sign-out separate from team administration.
flows.route: U01 → U02 → U03 → U04 → U03. Sign-out: U05 → A01. Expiry returns to the authorized original location after login.
flows.policy: Current session policy is 30-minute idle expiry and an eight-hour maximum. Secure draft recovery must never persist sensitive form data in browser storage.

screens.name: Your profile
screens.description: Own profile and preferences with a clear saved/unsaved state.
screens.rule: Separate personal settings from staff permission controls. Security-sensitive identity changes need their own verification.

screens.name: Account security
screens.description: Password/recovery guidance, proposed MFA setup and a link to active sessions.
screens.rule: Never show passwords or recovery secrets in history. Define lost-device recovery and MFA enrollment before launch.

screens.name: Active sessions
screens.description: Label the current session, other devices and recent activity with coarse device information.
screens.rule: Only view/revoke your own sessions unless an explicitly authorized administrative workflow applies.

screens.name: Revoke a session
screens.description: Name the selected device and explain it will need to sign in again.
screens.rule: Do not revoke the wrong device after stale data changes. Confirm and refresh the list after the server succeeds.

screens.name: Signed out / session expired
screens.description: Explain whether sign-out was requested or the session expired, and provide a direct return.
screens.rule: Clear private cached data on sign-out. Reauthenticate before exposing a draft or returning to a private record.
